info.name: Society Management API
info.description:
Works against the dynamic-roles model (V3). Run the folders top to bottom, or the whole collection in the Runner — every request has a status assertion.

1. Auth logs in as the platform SUPER_ADMIN (Stan Lee) — everything in folders 2–6 runs with {{superAdminToken}}.
2–5 build a fresh society → wing → flat and create a SECRETARY, GUARD and RESIDENT in it (random phones, password Pass@123), saving every id.
6 logs in as those users; 7 runs the visitor gate flow; 8–9 exercise role assignment and role definitions; 10 checks what each role must NOT be able to do; 14 runs maintenance billing and payments in the new society.

Existing local data: Nick Fury (9000000616) is SECRETARY of Avengers Tower. Every local user's password is Pass@123.

21. Meetings & governance
item.description: Module 26, in the society from folders 2–5. Creates its own CHAIRMAN and a member (owner of a new flat) and leaves them, the meetings and the minutes behind (history). Plans an AGM for a few minutes from now so it can be held in the same run (short notice with a reason), RSVPs, hides a committee meeting from members, adjourns and cancels it, deletes a draft, takes attendance with a quorum of one flat for the run, marks the AGM held, runs a secret e-vote, defers an item, searches the register, and takes the minutes through send-back, approval by the chairman, a correction and the notice-board announcement. Run close to midnight (India time), the AGM may fall on the next day and attendance is refused until then.

22. Subscription & billing
item.description: Platform billing (module 30). Run against a backend with billing switched off (the default, BILLING_ENABLED unset): trials are started here explicitly. The main society gets a Basic trial (paid modules answer 402), then Premium. A second society on a no-trial plan is invoiced, part paid, credited and paid. Razorpay order creation answers 409 without RAZORPAY_KEY_ID/SECRET; signed webhooks need RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET equal to the razorpayWebhookSecret variable (otherwise they are refused and the tests accept that). Suspension by date is covered by the backend tests.
